verdict.line: You lose if Ornn pins you against terrain for his Q-into-E knockup combo; you win if you stun-engage with Q the moment his Q poke is down and chain W.

brief.thesis: Ornn's only real lane threat is landing Volcanic Rupture (Q) to slow you into a wall so Searing Charge (E) collides with terrain for a knockup — outside of that specific setup his kit is single-target and slow to reset. Volibear's passive attack-speed stacking, W's on-hit mark-and-heal, and a 300-range Q stun are built for exactly the kind of extended melee trade Ornn can't contest between cooldowns, which is why the data shows a lane and solo-kill edge for Volibear despite the close 48.3% head-to-head over 1349 games.

theirWindow.when: you're near a wall and his Q is up
theirWindow.what: Ornn is threatening to slow you with Volcanic Rupture and follow with Searing Charge into terrain for a shockwave knockup. Stay off walls whenever his Q (9/8.5/8/7.5/7s cooldown) is available.

yourWindow.when: his Q has just been thrown or missed
yourWindow.what: Close the gap with Thundering Smash for the speed boost and stun, then land W twice — the recast deals bonus damage and heals you through anything he gets back during his Q downtime.

powerCurve.note: Ornn's 800-range Q pokes before your E is up.
Q rank-ups let you stun-engage every cooldown.
R leap and bonus health enable tower dives.
Both scale into teamfight-oriented item spikes.

start.why: Doran's Ring is the dominant start at 77% pick and 48.4% win rate over 1224 games — the extra sustain and mana regen keep you trading through Ornn's Q poke instead of backing off.

boots.why: Highest win rate and pick rate of the two boot options (49.2%, 40.6% pick); the tenacity shortens how long Ornn's Q slow and ult slow pin you in place for his follow-up.

core.why: Highest-winrate core path opener (52.3% over 149 games) — builds your attack speed early so your passive's bonus magic damage starts proccing sooner.
The cooldown refund tightens your Q stun and W mark-and-heal loop, letting you force more trade windows per minute than Ornn's longer Q/E cooldowns allow.
Healing amp plus magic resist directly counters Ornn's magic damage kit while boosting the self-heal from your double-tapped W.

situational.when: ornn's team is stacking healing or lifesteal you need to cut down
the game goes long and you need more sustained dps to break through his armor stacking
you want extra poke damage and sustain for skirmishes around objectives

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping attack speed matches your passive's on-attack scaling and rewards the extended W-stacking trades this matchup is built around.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the most-picked combo (65.6%) and fits the aggressive, solo-kill-favoured shape of this matchup — Ignite secures the kill once your Q stun and double W land.

playing.title: Avoid walls when his combo is up
playing.detail: Volcanic Rupture slows and drops a magma pillar at its end location; if Searing Charge then collides with terrain near you it creates a knockup shockwave. Reposition away from lane walls whenever both his Q and E are off cooldown.

playing.title: Trade the instant his Q is down
playing.detail: His Q cooldown (9/8.5/8/7.5/7s) is his only ranged poke. The moment he throws it, close with Thundering Smash for the speed boost and stun before he can reset.

playing.title: Double-tap W every extended trade
playing.detail: Recasting Frenzied Maul on the same marked target deals bonus damage and heals you — use this every fight to out-sustain his poke damage.

playing.title: Use E to zone, not to burst
playing.detail: Sky Splitter slows on hit and shields you if you're inside the blast (16s cooldown, 1200 range) — throw it to contest minions rather than hoarding it, since he out-cycles a passive E.

playing.title: Dive with R at level 6
playing.detail: Stormbringer grants bonus health on landing and temporarily disables nearby towers — use this spike to force all-ins under tower where he has no peel for a single diver.

playing.title: Punish a whiffed Searing Charge
playing.detail: His E only knocks up if he hits terrain; if it whiffs in open lane he's defenseless for 14-12s. Immediately Q-stun and chain W while it's down.

playing.title: Build into the cooldown loop
playing.detail: Navori Flickerblade's haste is the single highest-impact spike for this matchup — it lets your Q/W cycle outrun his Q/E cycle over the course of the lane.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, runes, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch; the tactical reasoning — wall positioning, trade timing, cooldown windows — is my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Ornn’s (Q)-(E) combo. Use [E] to contest lane while using [Q] to fight him in melee combat whenever he is in range.
